## About
Custom Empire is a custom shop on S Orange Ave in Orlando. We do custom paint and body kits, custom fabrication, classic car restoration, custom interiors, wheels and tires, and more. Your vision guides our work, and we collaborate closely with you from start to finish.
Marty Cyr is our general manager. The team includes KG, Xavier on paint prep, Luis on paint and Luis O as our mechanic. Customers have rated us 4.8 from 86 Google reviews.
Whether it's a widebody install, a full build or fixing a car after an accident, we take care with the small details, like paint matching, fitment and cleaning up the car after the work is done.

## Services
- Classic Car Restoration: Every vintage vehicle has a story. We bring classic cars back to the road with care for the history in every detail.
- Truck Accessories: Accessories for trucks that see rugged terrain or city streets. Explore our builds and options to customize your ride.
- Custom Fabrication: Have an idea for your vehicle? Our team turns it into metal and wheels.
- Custom Paint and Body Kits: Unique custom paint and body kits, built around what you want your car to look like.
- Mobile Electronics: Tech upgrades that keep you connected, entertained and on course.
- Detail, Coating, and Films: Detailing, coatings and protective films that bring out the shine and help shield your car from wear and tear.
- Custom Interiors: Comfortable, personal interiors made to fit the way you drive.
- Wheels and Tires: Safety, stability and style from the ground up.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you help after an accident?
A: Yes. One customer brought his truck in after an accident and said KG and Marty handled everything with the insurance adjusters. Another had his rear-ended Ranger repaired here.

Q: Do you do mechanical work too?
A: We do. One longtime customer had his exhaust system replaced here, and Luis O is our mechanic.

Q: Can I see my car while it's being worked on?
A: One couple said we kept them informed throughout their custom install and let them see the work when they stopped by to drop off parts.
